name: shared-select
goal: Every select control of the Harness website is the one shared Select component: the report hub filters, the comparison uploader, the console branch, commit and base selectors, the comparison scenario, state, viewport and record choices and the growth component choice render it, as the gallery, audio uploader, replay and provider picker already do; native select markup stays inside the component, which keeps string values, bindings, form names, labels, disabled and required states, an id, keyboard selection and one scoped style

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Daniel asked for one shared Select used wherever the website has a select. Discovery: packages/reports/src/components/Select.svelte (reports.component.select) was already used by the gallery filter, the audio uploader, the replay speed and scene and the provider picker; eleven fields were still written by hand in HubView (status, mode), UploadComparison (viewport), HarnessSelectors (branch, commit, base), HarnessCompareMedia (scenario, state, viewport, base and head record) and HarnessGrowth (component). No other production file writes a select; the provider picker is a separate build and already uses the component, so there is no exception. Success: one implementation, native markup only inside it, the same values, bindings, form names, labels, disabled state, paths and scoping as before, keyboard and phone behaviour of a native field, one scoped style. Proof: a component contract test, a reuse guard in the normal unit run, browser specs for every surface at 1440, 920 and 390 pixels with keyboard choices and downstream values, the unchanged browser suite, package tests and bun run check.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Select.svelte gained an id and a required state for its native field, a span wrapper so a label may hold it, and field and caret rules under its own class so a rule of a surface cannot outrank them; no change-handler property was added because a function binding already gives one. The eleven fields became the component: bind:value where the value was bound, a function binding to the existing navigation callbacks for branch, commit, base and component, name and disabled for the uploader. No style sheet of a surface changed. Units: reports.component.select, hub-view, upload-comparison, harness-harness-selectors, harness-harness-compare-media, harness-harness-growth; manifests re-indexed, the Select responsibility declared, the feature specification states the rule. Frozen limits were measured and not changed; the overages are reported to Codex.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Red on the unchanged product at 2ba610b: work/select/logs/unit-RED.log (test/components/select.test.ts and test/utils/select-reuse.test.ts: 3 failed, 2 characterizations passed) and work/select/logs/browser-RED.log (tests/e2e/shared-select-reports.spec.ts and shared-select-console.spec.ts: 18 failed; 15 on the missing caret of the shared select, 3 because the replay field kept 12 pixels beside a caret that needs 30). Hashes of the test files and logs: work/select/red/red-test-hashes.txt and red-log-hashes.txt; the same files, checked by hash, are green: work/select/logs/unit-GREEN.log (5 passed) and browser-GREEN.log (18 passed). Two earlier drafts of the browser specs had mistakes of their own, found by running every step after the shared-field check against the unchanged product, and were corrected before the recorded red. Existing behaviour tests passed before and after: the gallery, audio uploader and provider picker fields, and every choice, path and upload of the new specs with the shared-field check left out (work/select/logs/browser-flows-before.log, browser-flows-before-2.log, browser-existing-consumers-before.log, picker-before.log). Screenshots before and after at three widths were looked at: work/select/red/screenshots-before, work/select/green/screenshots-after; the real history of this repository, read with GET only: work/select/own-captures.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: bun run check exit 0 on the working tree (work/select/logs/check-2.log): 462 unit tests with 25 live-API tests skipped, 187 command-line end-to-end tests in 57 files, 26 package tests with 3 scale tests skipped (the packaged console with the shared select installed in a host: console-install, console-host-routes, console-storage, history-fresh-viewer), the three browser-run tests one after another with 5 passed, 132 reports unit tests in 58 files, audit and registry check passed (549 units, 16 uncertain references: the reuse guard reads the whole source directory, as the key guard reads its own). The first check was red and is kept (work/select/logs/check-1-RED-format.log): the loop file as created was not formatted. Whole browser suite on the final build: 150 passed, 1 skipped as before (work/select/logs/browser-suite.log); provider picker under its own configuration: 2 passed (work/select/logs/picker-after.log). Frozen limits compared with harness budget measure (work/select/budget-measure-after.txt): six units are over a frozen limit and none was changed here; that is Codex's review. The complete verification was not run; it is Codex's.
